coaching_note: Ashley told Jules upfront she's price-shopping — that's exactly the moment to lead with Einstein's differentiators (No Worries coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, Save Your Ass prep tips) before quoting a bare hourly number, since a generic rate with no story behind it gives her nothing to compare favorably against the next mover she calls.
